maya: Heads up — saw a perf regression on canary after enabling partial per-layer int4 with embedding+lm_head excluded. Throughput down ~18% on 8k seq workloads, tail latency spikes when KV cache warms. Profiling attached:

```SERVE_PROF
model: t5x-like
config: per-layer-int4, exclude: [embed, lm_head]
seq=8192 batch=8
p50: 45ms -> 37ms (good)
p95: 380ms -> 290ms (worse)
tokens/sec: 1200 -> 980 (-18%)
kv-cache-miss-rate: 12% -> 28%
kernel_switches: 3.2k -> 7.9k
```

jordan: did we change kernel selector thresholds? looks like more kernel thrashing — see kernel_selector.log from yesterday.

ryan: I pushed a tweak yesterday — lowered `min_seq_for_fp8` to 64 to prefer int4 for short sequences; might cause fragility for long sequences. Revert or add hysteresis? Also KV cache eviction seems higher — could be per-layer kv layout change.

lee: quick repro: run `./bench --model x --profile kv --layout partial` shows evict on layers 2-3. Maybe first transformer blocks are more sensitive; embed exclusion helps accuracy but changes memory touches.

maya: proposed plan:
1) add sticky kernel selection for session (avoid switching per request)
2) add per-model hysteresis window for seq distribution
3) increase kv-prefetch window on partial-quant models
Canary test targets: >95% throughput baseline and <5% kv-miss.

ops-bot: deploy Canary #482 started (canaryers: ryan,maya) — logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/482

jordan: also add a calibration check: when we exclude embed/lm_head, calibration stats for intermediate layers shift — need to run layer-sensitivity scan (per-layer MSE + perplexity probe) before rolling.

maya: I'll run layer-sensitivity scan overnight and post results. For immediate rollback we can pin kernel selector to `stable-int8` for canary.

ryan: ack. If anyone sees >20% regression tag me. :eyes:
